name: LOOP THE LOOP Side Story
original_name: LOOP THE LOOP サイドストーリー
source:
This is a collection of official side stories from the LOOP THE LOOP series.
They include details about each character's past that couldn't be fully depicted in the main story, and behind-the-scenes stories seen from another character's perspective.

[Translated from [url=https://sweetampoule.sakura.ne.jp/ltl_side.html]Official Site[/url]]
